subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` automatically attempt Gateway reattach and cache-only replay before the existing isolated embedded fallback after an uncertain accepted run disconnects?
rationale: This branch changes the user-facing disconnect contract and adds a Gateway protocol surface; the linked canonical issue intentionally requested owner direction before adopting that policy.

options.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
options.body: Adopt the new recovery sequence, align the PR body with the final automatic-fallback behavior, and require final-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep immediate isolated fallback
options.body: Retain the current recovery contract and remove the new replay protocol and CLI recovery path from this PR.

options.title: Split policy from mechanism
options.body: Land no behavior change now and continue the protocol design only after the owner specifies the intended retry, timeout, and delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
recommendation.body: Adopt the new recovery sequence, align the PR body with the final automatic-fallback behavior, and require final-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current main-branch fallback behavior and is best placed to choose whether recovery should precede it.
